user.title: Connect PESC personal account
user.description: Choose the cabinet first: individual accounts use ikus.pesc.ru, legal accounts use lk.pesc.ru. For unattended login, paste the permanent Base32 TOTP secret or the full otpauth:// URI.

reauth_confirm.title: Reconnect PESC personal account
reauth_confirm.description: Update all three credentials. The TOTP value must be the permanent secret or otpauth:// URI, not a six-digit code.

error.invalid_auth: PESC rejected the login, password, or TOTP code
error.invalid_totp: The TOTP secret or otpauth URI is invalid

abort.already_configured: This PESC login is already configured

submit_readings.name: Submit meter readings
submit_readings.description: Validate and submit a complete set of meter readings to PESC.
